errors.evidence: The y-axis is not labeled in the figure.

errors.text_span: Диапазонът на стойностите е от 0.0 до 1.5
errors.evidence: The y-axis range shown in the figure is from -0.5 to 1.5.

errors.text_span: Данните са представени с две линии.
errors.evidence: The chart shows three lines: one solid blue line and two dotted red lines.

errors.text_span: Първата, представена с червено, е плътна линия
errors.evidence: The solid line in the chart is blue, not red.

errors.text_span: и показва стационарна стойност на приблизително 0.1 през целия период от време.
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect description of the solid line. The solid (blue) line starts at a value of approximately 0.55 and decreases gradually to about 0.4. It is not stationary and is never at 0.1.

errors.text_span: Втората линия е представена с червено и е пунктирана, и показва стойност на приблизително 0.0 през целия период от време.
errors.evidence: This is a completely inaccurate description. There are two dotted red lines. Neither is stationary at 0.0. The upper dotted red line increases from about 1.05 to 1.5. The lower dotted red line decreases from about 0.05 to approximately -0.8.
